title: Fatal Fury
note: Neo Geo fighting game: health, timer, 14 characters, the rounds won and the round (1.33, the captures).

retroarch.note: FinalBurn Neo core: Neo Geo 68000 RAM seen from 0x100000, bytes swapped within 16-bit words

credits.note: MVS credits (backup RAM), readable in MAME only

p1_mode.note: BIOS: player 1, 0 never played, 1 playing, 2 continue, 3 game over

p2_mode.note: BIOS: player 2, same values. Reads 2 while player 1 plays alone (the capture of 2026-11-04): the tag p2_mode keeps 1 only when player 2 really plays

bios_request.note: BIOS_USER_REQUEST: 2 demo, 3 title screen (asked by the BIOS when a coin goes in on an MVS)

bios_timer.note: BIOS_COMPULSION_TIMER: seconds left on the title screen before the game starts by itself

bios_mvs.note: BIOS_MVS_FLAG: 0 home console (AES, no coins), otherwise arcade (MVS)

health.note: player 1 health in %, full = 0x60; a K.O. can take it below zero, read 0xFF... and shown full before 1.31.1: from 0xB0 it reads empty (K.O. audit)

_p2_hp.note: player 2's own health, a human playing against player 1 in %, full = 0x60; a K.O. can take it below zero, read 0xFF... and shown full before 1.31.1: from 0xB0 it reads empty (K.O. audit)

_cpu_hp.note: health of the computer's fighter, a block of its own (FBNeo and MAME cheats, Infinite Energy CPU; RetroAchievements code notes, P2 Health 60 max) in %, the same scale as the players'; when player 2 does not play (1.31.1, K.O. audit: the right bar never moved against the computer)

_time_sub.note: the timer's fraction of a second (RetroAchievements code notes, 0x42f5 Round timer osclilator), it moves at every frame once the round's timer runs, FIGHT ! waits for it to come with the game's own FIGHT or GO (1.31.1)

score.note: player 1 score, BCD (RetroAchievements rich presence, from tools/ra_notes.py), to confirm in game

score_p2.note: player 2, not found yet: three probes (_sc2_a, _sc2_b, _sc2_c) wait for a two-player capture (1.33)

_cpu_chr.note: the computer's fighter, in its own block like its health (RetroAchievements 0x530 P2 Character; the capture of 18:08: 6, MICHAEL, as on screen)

rounds.note: player 1 rounds won (RetroAchievements 0x42e7 P1 won rounds, the byte next to it as for the timer; the capture of 2026-11-04 18:08, the probes)

rounds_p2.note: player 2 or computer rounds won (RetroAchievements 0x42e6; the capture: 1 then 2 as he lost two rounds)

round.note: the round of the match, from 0 (RetroAchievements 0x24 Round; the capture: 1 at the second round)

_round_result.note: RetroAchievements 0x42e2 Round result: 0x0a round active against the computer, 0x06 against a human, 0x02 P1 won, 0x08 P2 won, 0x00 draw (the capture: 10 at each round, 8 at each round he lost); read for the captures

_sc2_a.note: probe (1.33): player 2 score, player 1's + 0x100 like the health blocks? a two-player capture says

_sc2_b.note: probe (1.33): player 2 score, right after player 1's?

_sc2_c.note: probe (1.33): player 2 score, 8 bytes after player 1's?

p2_mode.note: player 2 plays only while the BIOS says 1; it says 2 while player 1 plays alone (the capture, 1.33)

health_p2.note: the computer's health, or player 2's when player 2 plays

p2_char.note: the computer's fighter, or player 2's when player 2 plays (1.33)

capture_renames.note: values renamed since the captures of 2026-11-04 (probes confirmed), for tools/replay_capture.py

hd.note: the game empties a blow from its bar in two steps a fifth of a second apart: one blow for the effects and the hits counted (1.38)

specials.note: special moves and supers of each fighter, shown under a human player's name (1.38): from the command list of MAME (command.dat 0.273, Fabricio Coroquer and AntoPISA), made by tools/command_dat.py
